elements.title: Figure 3.—Leading Import Sources (2019–22) of Nonfuel Mineral Commodities for Which the United States Was Greater Than 50% Net Import Reliant
elements.content:
World map with countries colored by number of commodities for which the U.S. was >50% net import reliant during 2019-22.

EXPLANATION (Number of commodities):
- White: 0
- Light yellow: 1 to 3
- Yellow: 4 to 6
- Orange: 7 to 12
- Dark orange: 13 to 18
- Red: 19 to 24

Countries and their colors:
- Canada: Red (19 to 24)
- China: Red (19 to 24)
- United States: Gray (not colored)
- Brazil: Orange (7 to 12)
- Mexico: Orange (7 to 12)
- South Africa: Orange (7 to 12)
- Russia: Orange (7 to 12)
- Australia: Yellow (4 to 6)
- India: Yellow (4 to 6)
- Estonia, Belarus, Ukraine: Orange (7 to 12)
- Finland, Norway, Netherlands, Ireland, Belgium, Germany, Poland, Kazakhstan: Yellow (4 to 6)
- Turkey: Light blue (not in legend, presumably 0 or special)
- Austria, France, Italy, Switzerland: boxed together in light blue box
- Japan, Republic of Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam, Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia: Yellow (4 to 6)
- Peru, Bolivia, Chile: Yellow (4 to 6)
- Guyana: Light yellow (1 to 3)
- Jamaica: Light yellow (1 to 3)
- Gabon, Congo (Kinshasa), Madagascar: Light yellow (1 to 3)

All other countries mostly white (0).

Source: U.S. Geological Survey
